name: Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited
summary: Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited provides healthcare services in China. It operates hospitals and medical centers. The company also engages in insurance broking, E-commerce, health and asset management, tourism, professional design, technological development, food and beverages, and pharmaceutical production business. The company was formerly known as Xi'an Kaiyuan Investment Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited in January 2015. Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Xi'an, China.
